dict.2–12 poze ale aceleiași priveliști, făcu: 2–12 photos of the same view, taken side by side, stitched into one wide picture
dict.Caut părțile comune și lipesc pozele…: Finding the shared parts and stitching the photos…
dict.Nu am găsit o parte comună între poze, a: I found no shared part between the photos, so I did not make the panorama. The photos should overlap by about a third, as in a handheld panorama.
dict.Panoramă: 2–12 poze ale aceleiași privel: Panorama: 2–12 photos of the same view, taken side by side, stitched into one wide picture
dict.Pentru o panoramă alege cel puțin 2 poze: For a panorama, choose at least 2 photos that share a part (Ctrl+click them in the window).
dict.poze. Le pun în ordinea potrivită singur: photos. I put them in the right order myself; they should overlap by about a third, with the camera held level.
dict.Una dintre poze nu a putut fi deschisă,: One of the photos could not be opened, so I did not make the panorama.
dict.Pozele se întind întâi pe un cilindru, c: The photos are first wrapped onto a cylinder, as for panoramas taken by turning on the spot; untick for photos taken walking along a wall or for scans
dict.Pozele sunt făcute rotindu-mă pe loc (pr: The photos were taken turning on the spot (cylindrical projection)
